text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(—I've set up the perfect chance to invite 
them out. All right... h-here goes!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...! Um... t-to tell the truth, 
there's a place I'd like to go—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, we arrived at the zoo.
choice_data_list: It's been so long since I went to a zoo!
It's been so long since I went to a zoo!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me too...! ...Guess we have that lucky 
lottery win to thank!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Though truth be told, I spun that 
raffle wheel like my life depended on it. 
Anyway, all that's left is to tour the zoo 
according to plan...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(To deepen our bond outside of racing, 
race talk is forbidden... Race talk is 
forbidden!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-It ate it...! Giraffe tongues really 
are so long, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Carrots are delicious, aren't they? 
I love them too.
choice_data_list: ...Want some?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-I won't eat it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible, Trainer-san! There are birds 
on your hands, your shoulders, and even 
your head...!
choice_data_list: Ugh, I can't move...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(So far, everything's going smoothly... 
right? After this, we take a short break, 
and then head to the main petting area—)

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
The "All-Kinds-of-Animals Race" is 
starting soon! Head over to the Savanna 
Area, go~!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Various Animals Race"...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ah! No, no, no...! No racing allowed 
today—)
choice_data_list:
There's a race, huh? Sounds fun, shall we 
go check it out?

There's a race, huh? Sounds fun, wanna go 
check it out?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, Race 1! The 'Moshi Moshi 
Kame-san Cup' is underway!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Th-This is part of the fun of the zoo, 
right? ...Still, better be careful how I 
talk.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Turtles are faster than I thought. I 
always imagined them to be much slower...
choice_data_list:
I just can't shake the impression from the 
old tales.

I just can't shake the impression from the 
old tales.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! Turtle Number 3! It's making a 
massive surge from the back...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the one in 1st is falling behind, 
aren't they? It goes to show that in the 
final meter, late-race burst is—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Is the finishing kick impowtant? What's a 
finishing kick?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah! U-Um... well, you see... 
err......"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to just watch him panic, I knelt 
down beside the boy. ...If I'm going to 
explain it to a young child—
choice_data_list:
A finishing kick is that super dash right 
at the end, you know

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Super dash? ...Ah! It really is! Turtle 
number 3 is on a super dash!!
choice_data_list: Exactly! That's what a late surge is!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
And now for Race 2! Race 2 is the "Hoppin' 
Bunny Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Which one is the fastest now? I 
wanna see their finishing kicks!
choice_data_list:
Hmm? ...Chrono, which one do you think it 
is?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! ...Ummm. Y-Yeah, let's see... maybe 
number 5, for example.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
From the paddock... looking at how she's 
acting while waiting, it seems like... 
she's staring at the carrots at the goal 
line...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just as expected... they'll burst 
out front right away and make a runaway 
victory out of it.
choice_data_list:
We might even get to see her closing kick 
as she dashes for the carrots.

We might even get to see her closing kick 
as she dashes for the carrots, you know.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Good luck on the home stretch!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected, horse girl number 5 
leaped out into the lead. She's holding 
the front. So far, it's going just as 
predicted—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Rabbit #4 sticking right behind is a 
little creepy, but there's only 1 meter 
left, so...
choice_data_list: No, number 4 has burst out to the outside!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Ah—! Number 4's late surge—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, but wait! The girl in #5 has that 
gutsy final spurt...!
choice_data_list: Go! Stay out in front!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...She made it! She won! She held on to 
win by a neck...!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I won! That late kick was incredible! 
You big sisters were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: But what does "by a neck" mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after enjoying our time at 
the zoo. However... Chrono Genesis seemed 
somewhat downcast.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Th-Thank you very much for 
today. For going out of your way to keep 
me company..."
choice_data_list: ...Did you get all tired out?
That "All Kinds of Animals Race" was fun.

That "All Kinds of Animals Race" was fun, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Th-Thank you very much for 
today. For going out of your way to keep 
me company..."
choice_data_list: ...Did you get all tired out?
That "All Kinds of Animals Race" was fun.

That "All Kinds of Animals Race" was fun, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! I-I'm okay...! I was just... thinking 
about how much fun it was...
choice_data_list: I see, that's a relief then.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Things were going so well halfway 
through. In the end, I just ended up 
having fun talking about races.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I ended up making Trainer worry about me 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...N-No, no, no! That was just the first 
try! Next time, it'll be perfect...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yup! That's... right!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I would've liked to see elephants or 
lions too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. It looks like it will 
be a dynamic race, quite different from an 
Umamusume race—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Aaaah! I did it again...! I'm forbidden 
from racing today...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...N-No, no, no! That was just the first 
try! Next time, it'll be perfect...!)
